assessment_published.name: assessment_published
assessment_published.value: "assessment"."status" <> 'PUBLISHED' OR ("assessment"."published_by" IS NOT NULL AND "assessment"."published_at" IS NOT NULL)

attendance_edit_request_decided.name: attendance_edit_request_decided
attendance_edit_request_decided.value: "attendance_edit_request"."status" = 'PENDING' OR ("attendance_edit_request"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "attendance_edit_request"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

class_session_marked.name: class_session_marked
class_session_marked.value: "class_session"."status" <> 'HELD' OR ("class_session"."marked_by" IS NOT NULL AND "class_session"."marked_at" IS NOT NULL)

college_settings_pct_range.name: college_settings_pct_range
college_settings_pct_range.value: "college_settings"."attendance_min_pct" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "college_settings"."attendance_warn_pct" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "college_settings"."low_marks_pct" BETWEEN 0 AND 100

leave_notice_approval.name: leave_notice_approval
leave_notice_approval.value: "leave_notice"."status" = 'PENDING' OR ("leave_notice"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "leave_notice"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL)

parent_contact_consent_method.name: parent_contact_consent_method
parent_contact_consent_method.value: "parent_contact"."consent_at" IS NULL OR "parent_contact"."consent_method" IS NOT NULL

role_grant_scope.name: role_grant_scope
role_grant_scope.value:
("role_grant"."role" IN ('ADMIN','PRINCIPAL') AND "role_grant"."department_id" IS NULL AND "role_grant"."class_group_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("role_grant"."role" = 'HOD' AND "role_grant"."department_id" IS NOT NULL AND "role_grant"."class_group_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("role_grant"."role" = 'CLASS_TEACHER' AND "role_grant"."class_group_id" IS NOT NULL AND "role_grant"."department_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("role_grant"."role" = 'FACULTY' AND "role_grant"."class_group_id" IS NULL)

timetable_slot_kind_fields.name: timetable_slot_kind_fields
timetable_slot_kind_fields.value:
("timetable_slot"."kind" = 'CLASS' AND "timetable_slot"."offering_id" IS NOT NULL AND "timetable_slot"."component" IS NOT NULL)
       OR ("timetable_slot"."kind" = 'ACTIVITY' AND "timetable_slot"."offering_id" IS NULL AND "timetable_slot"."component" IS NULL)
